mandate: One pet per creation: arbitrary authored ink, a permanent hidden seed, and chronological care drive that SAME organism through potentially dramatic developmental forms guided by a scientifically sourced phylogenetic possibility map. No breeding, reproduction, offspring, multi-generation mechanics or heritable change between creatures.

lifecycle.completeMeans: Every acceptance marker is asserted in the focused test file and passes in CI. A task is not done from screenshots, prose or partial implementation.

invariants: One creature exists per creation. Its initial drawing, persistent identity, and hidden seed remain the same throughout its lifetime; no breeding, offspring or multi-generational progression.

The game uses a real phylogenetic reference as a branching map of possible developmental forms for the SAME creature over time. The observed affinity/path may progress, but is not literal taxonomic evolution or scientific ancestry-changing.
All apparent evolutionary changes are within one pet's lifetime. Genetic potential is assigned once and remains fixed; care affects how the potential is expressed.
No reference sprites, species IDs or historical stages in the runtime phenotype generator.
Retain exact authored birth ink and traceable source-material ancestry.
Scientific taxonomy and fictional extensions have distinct, inspectable provenance.
A replay witness is source drawing, seed, engine version, chronological care history, and times.
Avoid generated screenshots, recordings or diagnostic bulk files in main; use small deterministic numeric tests.
Every agent reads this plan before touching the engine, updates task status and acceptance tests together.

tasks.title: Canonical machine-readable roadmap and focused test runner

acceptance.requirement: Invalid task graphs and unevidenced completion are rejected
Each completed acceptance criterion is linked to an executable test

tasks.title: Remove accumulated prototype test corpus and allocate algorithm ownership

acceptance.requirement: Only four targeted numeric test modules remain; no old prototype-wide scan suite.
Verification runs roadmap check, typecheck, narrow tests, and not duplicate exports.
Every task has one algorithm owner and non-overlapping assigned write scope.
CI test discovery derives automatically from completed tasks and small explicit baseline tests.

tasks.title: Extract label-independent connectedness, symmetry and bounds from arbitrary ink

acceptance.requirement: A single blob, disconnected marks, and empty ink have stable exact signatures
Pigment, layer ordering and part labels cannot change an otherwise identical silhouette

tasks.title: Represent multiple biological affinities with explicit uncertainty

acceptance.requirement: Ambiguous and blank drawings are not confidently classified as animals
Output maintains inspectable evidence and probabilistic alternatives

interfaceContract.output: AffinityInference with candidate evidence, normalized heuristic weights, uncertainty, and provenance-verified taxonomic references
interfaceContract.verification: Scientific references looked up exclusively through the merged src/phylogeny API
interfaceContract.biologicalMeaning: Static scientific reference possibilities for one evolving pet; no committed species label, taxonomic ancestry change, or reproduction

tasks.title: Test shape inference under translation and small drawing perturbations

acceptance.requirement: Translation and repainting preserve equivalent biological evidence
One-pixel perturbations do not force arbitrary confident taxonomy jumps

interfaceContract.output: Per-case evidence drift, total variation in heuristic weights, confidence-jump detection
interfaceContract.biologicalMeaning: One-pixel edits cannot independently change scientific taxon references; small score/rank variations remain possible

tasks.title: Establish the cross-kingdom phylogenetic possibility map for one pet's growth

acceptance.requirement: Plant, fungal and animal ancestors have traceable external taxon IDs and source versions
All parent edges are acyclic and scientifically sourced; unknown roots remain unknown

interfaceContract.purpose: Represent a small multi-kingdom scientific reference tree, retaining historical OpenTree animal identifiers and evidence; all edges are reference ancestry, possibly contracted over omitted taxa.
inputs: 11 hand-selected dated NCBI Taxonomy Browser references
outputs: PhylogenyView: getNode, parentOf, childrenOf, ancestry, commonAncestor, isDescendant, lineageMembership, getProvenance, validate
scientific provenance with OTT/NCBI identifiers and access-date or release labeling
interfaceContract.unknownBehavior: Unrepresented taxa return undefined/empty, and no unsourced intermediary node is inserted

tasks.title: Compile ancestral anatomical constraints for single-creature developmental paths

acceptance.requirement: Scientific reference taxa inherit and may refine ancestral biological constraints; these are taxonomy relationships, not reproduction between virtual pets

A typed single-pet waypoint descriptor can move among anatomical inspirations from different reference clades, with stable scientific birth-reference ancestry; rendering the physical transformations remains an integration-dependent task

interfaceContract.purpose: Evidence-backed anatomical traits belong to reference taxa; single-pet growth can draw on changing biological inspirations and the birth reference is not a lifetime prohibitive gate.
inputs: birthReferenceId: a candidate reference, not a verified diagnosis
candidateReferenceIds?: readonly string[] (defaults to all represented)
waypoints: readonly {atHour, anatomicalReferenceId, influence}[] supplied externally
outputs: DevelopmentPrior: sourced reference-clade constraints, operator hints, semantics=reference-clade-evidence-not-lifetime-gate
DevelopmentalPossibilityMap: anatomical inspirations across branches, source-relative graph distance, provenance, fixedBirthReferenceLineage
LifetimeDevelopmentalTrajectory: chronologically validated inspiration waypoints, generic operator hints, execution=development-engine-not-implemented
interfaceContract.missingIntegration: No classifier selection, seed/care waypoint planning, phenotype realization, or physical continuity validation in this module. Development and integration owners must implement these downstream.

tasks.title: Support speculative single-pet developmental destinations, separated from scientific taxa

acceptance.requirement: Every speculative node is machine-identifiable as fictional
Speculative phenotypes remain compatible with the shared developmental API

interfaceContract.purpose: Fictional overlays are explicit non-scientific provenance and offer generic anatomical inspirations; no named fantasy sprites or target species.
inputs: SpeculativeBranchInput[] with fiction: prefixed ID, represented parentId, name, rationale, operatorHints
outputs: fictional possibility entries via exploreDevelopmentalPossibilities and typed lifetime waypoints
interfaceContract.missingIntegration: No rendering engine is implemented. Fictional operator hints are only suggestions to the shared future Development agent.

acceptance.requirement: Each pet's genome is fixed at creation by its seed and compiled deterministically; no parent genomes, breeding, mating or inherited mutation across pets
Growth, support and pattern channels obey appropriate lineage constraints

tasks.title: Generate lifetime appendage growth and metamorphosis of the same animal-like pet

agentCoordination.writeOwnership: One algorithm owner writes each owned path; all other agents treat it as read-only. Shared imports are allowed. Owner boundaries are routing rules, not permission constraints.
agentCoordination.parallelExecution: Agents can develop algorithms concurrently against existing typed public interfaces. Cross-algorithm API changes require interface proposals to the integration owner before editing shared runtime files.
agentCoordination.taskLifecycle: Agent selects one task ID, reads acceptance contract and ownedPaths, writes smallest targeted test, implements algorithm, runs that test, updates status in same commit.
agentCoordination.integrationGate: Integration agent alone edits App.tsx, src/lineage/index.ts or src/simulation/growth.ts while separate algorithm work is in progress.
agentCoordination.testConvention: Every new algorithm-local test must be named tests/alg-<algorithmId>-<feature>.test.ts, be referenced in roadmap/plan.json and measure that feature only.
agentCoordination.reporting: Prefer booleans, numeric hashes, invariants and narrow metric summaries; never commit screenshot batches, historical build logs or generated test matrices.

singleCreatureLifecycle.unitOfSimulation: one continuously identifiable organism across its entire lifetime
singleCreatureLifecycle.creation: one authored drawing plus one once-assigned alphanumeric random seed
singleCreatureLifecycle.genotype: per-pet fixed developmental potential; no mating, meiosis, gametes, parent genomes, genetic recombination, offspring or inheritance across pets
singleCreatureLifecycle.progression: the same pet may undergo major anatomical evolution-like transformations as it ages, with chronological care and conditions influencing expression and divergence
singleCreatureLifecycle.phylogeny: the scientific tree supplies hierarchical anatomical constraints and branching possibilities for single-pet developmental trajectories; stage affinities along its branches may change, but this is a game developmental metaphor, not a claim that an individual changes its actual scientific ancestry

terminology.phylogeneticAncestor: a reference node in a biological taxonomy, not a parent pet
terminology.phylogeneticDescendant: a reference taxon descended in the real tree of life, never offspring produced by this pet
terminology.inheritedGenome: stable latent individual traits assigned at creation, not traits passed to children
terminology.evolutionaryPath: one creature's sequential changes over time, not multiple generations or population evolution
